issues.title: Flat on the bed
issues.message: Nothing on the bottom of this part sits flat on the print bed — it is rounded or tilted. It will need supports and may wobble or detach while printing.
issues.suggestion: Rotate the part so its largest flat face is on the bottom, or add a flat base before exporting.

issues.title: Requires Support
issues.message: About 1477 mm² of overhangs (35° or less from horizontal) will need support. Highlighted areas show where.
issues.suggestion: Rotate the part so fewer surfaces face downward, or add chamfers under overhangs.

issues.title: 1 mm bottom chamfer
issues.message: Recommend adding 1mm chamfer to the base of all parts for maximum reliability and highest tolerance.

issues.title: No thin vertical stalks
issues.message: A column about 3.9 mm wide and 66.0 mm tall (17.0× taller than wide) may wobble while printing and snap off during handling.
issues.suggestion: Thicken the column to at least 2 mm, add a fillet or brace at its base, or print it lying down.

issues.title: No large spidery pieces
issues.message: This is a large part made of thin, spread-out arms (average thickness about 1.92 mm, fills 23% of its outline). Parts like this warp, break and are hard to ship.
issues.suggestion: Thicken the arms, add connecting webs, or split it into sturdier pieces.

issues.title: Potential Excessive Support
issues.message: Estimated support is about 282% of the part's volume (26.5 cm³ of support for 9.4 cm³ of part). Highlighted areas overhang 35° or less from horizontal.
issues.suggestion: Rotate the part to reduce overhangs, add chamfers under overhangs, or split it into pieces that print flat.
